_readme: FIAT GEAR - the four gap uniques (12 Oct, docs/design/uniques.md): the Starting Pistol, the Miner's Lamp, the Paramedic's Bumbag, the Plumber's Belt. One job each, written straight to the LIVE name art/items/<slug>.png; each at its base's footprint x 64 px. Until a file exists the cell draws the base's picture.

Run: godot --headless --script res://tools/pixellab_batch_v2.gd ++ --manifest res://tools/pixellab_items_gap_uniques_manifest.json   (++ --dry-run to list). Rides art/reference/items/ref_01..04.png as style like the rest of the pool. A job whose file exists is skipped; one that came out wrong: ++ --only <slug> ++ --force.
The same four jobs are in the uniques manifest when it's regenerated (python3 tools/make_item_manifests.py on the machine that holds the art).

jobs.description: A realistic painted pixel-art still-life of a single black athletics starting pistol rebored into a real handgun, seen exactly side-on with the muzzle pointing left, laid level and filling the frame left to right: a school sports day's pistol, the cylinder scratched, a strip of white tape round the grip with a PE department's initials in marker. One object centred and filling the frame, soft directional overcast daylight, natural material rendering with fine detail and painterly shading; no black outlines, no flat cel shading, not anime, not a cartoon, not a glossy video-game item; the look of a real object photographed on a grey day in a country that has run out of money. Muted cool northern palette, worn and repaired, nothing new. Nothing else in the frame, no hands, no person, no text, no logos, a plain dark neutral background.
